ALTER TABLE track
    ADD COLUMN lesson_read_access TEXT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT track_lesson_read_access_check
        CHECK (lesson_read_access IS NULL OR lesson_read_access IN ('guest', 'student', 'student_pro', 'disabled'));

ALTER TABLE course_level
    ADD COLUMN lesson_read_access TEXT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_level_lesson_read_access_check
        CHECK (lesson_read_access IS NULL OR lesson_read_access IN ('guest', 'student', 'student_pro', 'disabled'));

ALTER TABLE course_group
    ADD COLUMN lesson_read_access TEXT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_group_lesson_read_access_check
        CHECK (lesson_read_access IS NULL OR lesson_read_access IN ('guest', 'student', 'student_pro', 'disabled'));

ALTER TABLE course
    ADD COLUMN lesson_read_access TEXT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_lesson_read_access_check
        CHECK (lesson_read_access IS NULL OR lesson_read_access IN ('guest', 'student', 'student_pro', 'disabled'));

ALTER TABLE module
    ADD COLUMN lesson_read_access TEXT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT module_lesson_read_access_check
        CHECK (lesson_read_access IS NULL OR lesson_read_access IN ('guest', 'student', 'student_pro', 'disabled'));

ALTER TABLE section
    ADD COLUMN lesson_read_access TEXT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT section_lesson_read_access_check
        CHECK (lesson_read_access IS NULL OR lesson_read_access IN ('guest', 'student', 'student_pro', 'disabled'));

ALTER TABLE lesson
    ADD COLUMN lesson_read_access TEXT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT lesson_lesson_read_access_check
        CHECK (lesson_read_access IS NULL OR lesson_read_access IN ('guest', 'student', 'student_pro', 'disabled'));
